translations.web: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
translations.bsb: Then I will strike the bow from your left hand and dash down the arrows from your right hand.
translations.kjv: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
